body.name: Private-parent and occurrence-hub compiler
body.construction: For a promised encoding \(Q\), assign each coordinate a singleton master sink and make the master for \(s_Q\) the queried edge \(e_Q\); assign each normalized constraint fresh occurrence sinks with at most two private root parents; copy each occurrence to its master through a fresh singleton hub and two linear equality equations; realize each gate or copy equality in one distinct missing-sink pair using covariance slots that occur in no other missing-edge equation. Populate \(\rho_Q\) by the encoded assignment \(z_Q\) and its forced occurrence copies. Set unused off-diagonal entries to zero and every diagonal entry to \(1+\max_i\sum_{j\ne i}|(\Sigma_Q)_{ij}|\), and return \(\mathsf C(Q)=(G_Q,\Sigma_Q,e_Q,\rho_Q)\).
